column4: cleat#2306 phase 2: dialect-gated at the DIALECT GROUP, same shape as TestUninstallPluginRefusesAnUnprovenPluginOnEveryDialect in this same package -- PostgreSQL runs, MySQL and SQL Server skip in this PostgreSQL-only job before their per-plugin subtests ever start, two. Measured 2026-09-25 with only CLEAT_TEST_DB set: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/... -run TestUninstallDownChainIsClassifiedOnEveryDialect -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these two, 0 failures.
